body:
## What changed

Every Docs API document read (`documents.get`) now passes `num_retries=2` to the generated client, so transient transport failures (connection resets, 5xx, rate-limit responses) are retried twice with the client's built-in backoff before surfacing as an error. Writes (`batchUpdate`) are untouched and still run exactly once.

- `get_document`, `get_document_tabs`, `get_document_with_tabs`, and `get_document_structure` in `gdoc/api/docs.py` call `.execute(num_retries=2)`.
- The two post-write read-backs inside `_insert_table` and the fallback read in `replace_formatted` previously called `service.documents().get(...).execute()` directly. They now go through the shared `get_document` / `get_document_with_tabs` wrappers, so they get the same retry behavior and the same `HttpError` translation.
- On exhaustion the existing error handling is unchanged: the `HttpError` is translated to `GdocError`/`AuthError` at the API boundary as before.

## Why

`gdoc cat`, `edit`, `suggest`, and friends read the document before acting. A single dropped connection on that read made the whole command fail, even though a `GET` is idempotent and safe to repeat. Mutations are deliberately left non-retried: a retried `batchUpdate` could apply an edit or suggestion twice.

## How it was tested

- `uv run pytest tests/ -q` — 1572 passed.
- New tests in `tests/test_api_docs.py` assert the exact `documents().get(...)` kwargs and `num_retries=2` for each read wrapper, and that a read which fails once at the transport layer then succeeds is recovered (through both the API function and the CLI), while repeated failures still surface as an error.
- `tests/test_docs_batch.py` gains a test that a post-write read-back is retried while the `batchUpdate` before it is issued exactly once with no `num_retries`. `tests/test_suggest.py` assertions updated to match the exact `execute()` call on the suggestion write.
- `uv run ruff check gdoc/ tests/` — 196 findings, same count as `main` (pre-existing; none added). `bash scripts/check-no-stubs.sh` passes.
- Live check against a synthetic document: the `edit` read path recovered after one injected disconnect; no edit was issued and the document was trashed afterwards.
title: fix: retry idempotent Docs document reads twice
